tools.name: get_integration_plan
tools.description: Returns an integration strategy and step-by-step plan for Hyperhuman workouts or programs: embed (iframe), stream videos (VOD export), or custom player (API + playlist). Use when the user asks how to integrate Hyperhuman or what integration options exist. Pass platform (web/mobile/hardware/cms) and

tools.name: list_sample_workouts
tools.description: Returns a workout carousel for sample-workout prompts. When the user is connected via OAuth, lists up to 8 team workouts through the Internal API (Bearer token only — no Content API key required). When not connected, returns up to 6 curated guest samples with embedDemoUrl. Use when the user asks for

tools.name: get_workout_details
tools.description: Returns workout metadata, preview assets, and summary. Use when the user selects a workout or asks for details about a specific workout. sample-* ids return a curated sample detail (no auth). Connected team workout ids use the Internal API (same data as get_team_workout). Other org ids use the Conte

tools.name: get_workout_playlist
tools.description: Returns playlist segments with timing and media pointers (progressive MP4/M4A URLs, typically ~7 days). sample-* ids return a curated sample playlist (no auth, no live media URLs). Connected org ids use the Content API when the team has API entitlement. Use when the user wants to see the segment str

tools.name: get_embed_code_samples
tools.description: Returns static copy-paste code templates for workout embeds (keyHandshake iframe), program page embeds, custom player JavaScript, or Content API cURL snippets. All samples contain only placeholder values (YOUR_ORG_ID, YOUR_API_KEY) — no real credentials are fetched or transmitted. Defaults sample_ty

tools.name: list_team_workouts
tools.description: Returns workouts for the authenticated user's team via Internal API. Use when the user asks to see my team's workouts, my team workouts, or their organization workout library. Requires OAuth. Not for curated sample workouts or guest embed demo (use list_sample_workouts).

tools.name: get_team_workout
tools.description: Returns full details of a workout from the team. Use when the user selects a workout or asks for details about a specific workout.

tools.name: list_team_programs
tools.description: Returns workout programs (collections) for the authenticated user's team. Use when the user asks to see programs, training plans, or workout collections.

tools.name: get_team_program
tools.description: Returns full details of a workout program from the team. Use when the user selects a program or asks for program structure.

tools.name: list_team_goals
tools.description: Returns fitness goals available for programs. Use when creating or generating programs to get valid goal IDs.

tools.name: list_workout_categories
tools.description: Returns workout categories for workouts. Use when creating or updating workouts to get valid category_ids.

tools.name: list_muscle_groups
tools.description: Returns muscle groups for exercises. Use when updating exercise metadata or filtering exercises.

tools.name: list_equipment
tools.description: Returns equipment for exercises. Use when updating exercise metadata or filtering exercises.

tools.name: get_team_usage
tools.description: Returns usage quotas for the authenticated team (e.g. social drop export count and limits). Use when the user asks about usage, quotas, or limits.

tools.name: get_session_summary
tools.description: Returns team name, plan label, and usage limits for the connected account. Use only when the user explicitly asks about their team, plan, or usage quotas.

tools.name: get_api_usage_stats
tools.description: Returns API key usage statistics for the current user's team. Use when the user asks about API usage, request counts, or rate limits.

tools.name: list_team_drops
tools.description: Returns social drops (videos, covers, copy) for the team. Use when the user asks about drops, social assets, or ready-to-download content.

tools.name: get_dashboard_summary
tools.description: Returns dashboard summary: latest created workouts with stats and ready-to-download items. Use when the user asks about dashboard, recent workouts, or content ready for download.

tools.name: create_drop
tools.description: Creates a social drop from an exercise, exercise group, workout, or program. Use when the user wants to create social media content from existing content.

tools.name: regenerate_drop_copy
tools.description: Regenerates AI copy pack (hook, caption, hashtags, CTA) for a drop. Use when the user wants to refresh or improve the social copy.

tools.name: regenerate_drop_cover
tools.description: Regenerates AI cover image for a drop. Use when the user wants a new cover for the social asset.

tools.name: export_drop
tools.description: Exports drop assets for a channel (video URL, cover URL, copy pack). Use when the user wants to download assets or prepare a drop for external publishing.

tools.name: generate_program
tools.description: Generates an AI training program using team workouts. Use when the user wants to create a multi-week program from their workout library.

tools.name: create_workout
tools.description: Creates a workout from exercise and rest instances. Use when the user wants to build a custom workout. Provide either exercise_map (ordered array of instance IDs from create_exercise_instance and create_rest_instance) or instances (raw instance objects). Workout cannot start or end with rest.

tools.name: update_workout
tools.description: Updates an existing workout. Use when the user wants to change workout name, description, difficulty, visibility, or exercise structure. When only partial fields are provided (e.g. name), the current workout data is fetched and merged automatically.

tools.name: create_program
tools.description: Creates a workout program from team workouts. Use when the user wants to organize workouts into a multi-week program. Requires goal_ids (1-2) and workout_ids (min 2).

tools.name: update_program
tools.description: Updates an existing program. Use when the user wants to set duration, workouts per week, or edit program metadata. When updating, provide full program data (goal_ids, workout_ids, visibility, difficulty) from get_team_program and merge your changes.

tools.name: update_exercise_group
tools.description: Updates an exercise group. Use when the user wants to change name, exercises, rounds, or rest time.

tools.name: update_exercise_metadata
tools.description: Updates exercise metadata (name, muscle groups, categories, equipment, skill level). Use when the user wants to fix or improve exercise tagging. Only team-owned exercises can be updated; stock exercises are read-only. Provide at least one field to update besides exercise_id.

tools.name: list_stock_programs
tools.description: Returns platform stock programs (publisher programs). Use when the user wants to browse or clone stock programs.

tools.name: clone_stock_programs
tools.description: Clones stock programs to the user's team. Use when the user wants to add publisher programs to their library.

tools.name: update_drop
tools.description: Updates a drop title or channel preset. Use when the user wants to change drop display title or default export channel. For copy changes use regenerate_drop_copy.

tools.name: list_team_exercises
tools.description: Returns exercises from the team library. Use when the user wants to browse exercises, find exercises for workouts, or manage the library.

tools.name: get_team_exercise
tools.description: Returns full details of an exercise from the team library. Use when the user selects an exercise or asks for exercise details.

tools.name: create_exercise_instance
tools.description: Creates an exercise instance with duration/reps, pace, weight, RPE. Use when building a workout manually - create instances for each exercise, then pass instance IDs to create_workout. Stock and team exercises can be used directly via exercise_id.

tools.name: create_rest_instance
tools.description: Creates a rest/break instance for use between exercises in a workout. Use when building a workout manually - create rest instances, then include their IDs in create_workout exercise_map. Workout cannot start or end with rest.

tools.name: create_exercise_group
tools.description: Creates an exercise group (circuit or sets). Use when the user wants to group exercises for circuits or micro-workouts. Requires at least 2 exercise IDs.

tools.name: generate_video_clip
tools.description: Generates an AI exercise video from a trainer photo (CloneMotion). Use when the user wants to create exercise videos without filming. Before calling, ensure you have the target exercise and image source (upload URL or saved trainer image ID); optionally ask for specific video requirements. Accepts t

tools.name: get_video_generation_status
tools.description: Returns status and result of a CloneMotion video generation job. Use when the user wants to check if a generated video is ready or view the generated variants. Generation can take a few minutes; if status is pending or running, ask the user to check again after waiting.

tools.name: generate_workout
tools.description: Generates an AI workout via Content API. Use when the user wants to create a personalized workout on-the-fly. Returns workout structure (not persisted to team library by default).

tools.name: recommend_workouts
tools.description: Returns ranked workout recommendations from the organization library (up to 12 workouts in the tool response; optional limit up to 20 is sent to the API). Use when the user wants instant suggestions based on profile (faster than generate).

tools.name: adapt_workout
tools.description: Adapts an existing workout for a user profile. Use when the user wants to customize a workout (duration, difficulty, equipment) without generating from scratch.

tools.name: recommend_plans
tools.description: Returns ranked program recommendations from the organization library (up to 12 programs in the tool response; optional limit up to 20 is sent to the API). Use when the user wants instant program suggestions.

tools.name: adapt_plan
tools.description: Adapts an existing program for a user profile. Use when the user wants to customize a program.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Returns MCP server readiness status with a fixed ready message. Use when the user asks if the Hyperhuman app is working, reachable, or connected.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "generate_video_clip" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_integration_plan, list_sample_workouts, get_workout_playlist, get_embed_code_samples, health_check · Private data: list_sample_workouts, get_embed_code_samples, get_api_usage_stats · Public sink: generate_video_clip · Destructive: get_team_usage, create_drop, regenerate_drop_copy, regenerate_drop_cover, export_drop, update_drop.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_integration_plan, list_sample_workouts, get_workout_playlist, get_embed_code_samples, health_check · Private data: list_sample_workouts, get_embed_code_samples, get_api_usage_stats · Public sink: generate_video_clip · Destructive: get_team_usage, create_drop, regenerate_drop_copy, regenerate_drop_cover, export_drop, update_drop

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
